description: Incorporation of the Chartered Institute for Computing Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The ‘Computer Society of Sri Lanka’ was established in 1976 as the pioneer and sole body representing professionals in the Information and Communication Technology in Sri Lanka. It has been recognized the importance of establishing the Chartered Institute for Computing Sri Lanka as the main professional organization representing the aspirations of professionals engaged in the field of computing in Sri Lanka, enabling to treat on an equal footing with other professional organizations that have obtained chartered status and other formal recognitions. Accordingly, taking into consideration a proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, the Cabinet decided to grant policy approval to incorporate the Chartered Institute for Computing Sri Lanka, and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill in accordance with the proposed objectives for the purpose.
